chunks.content:

[2025-11-03 01:45] Kyle Wang: Notal Partnership Inquiry

Hi Kyle,I hope you’re doing well. I came across Notal while researching practice management platforms tailored for small to mid-sized firms, and I was immediately impressed by the product positioning and the thoughtful approach to AI-assisted workflows. Our firm is currently evaluating tools that can streamline intake, document management, and client communication without adding complexity for our attorneys, and Notal’s focus on keeping judgment firmly in the hands of lawyers resonates with what we need. I’d love to learn more about how you handle multi-tenant security, role-based permissions, and any audit logging or compliance features that make onboarding and recordkeeping painless for a legal team.We’re particularly interested in a short demo that highlights three things: practical, day-to-day workflows for intake-to-billing; your document and template handling (including version control and collaboration); and the way your AI suggestions are surfaced and moderated in the UI. Our current stack has a mix of legacy document storage and cloud drives, so a demo that shows migration paths, integration points (especially mailbox and calendar sync), and the administrative controls for client/matter scoping would be most helpful. If possible, please also touch on pricing models for small firms and any pilot options or limited-scope trials, we prefer to start with a single practice group and expand once we validate benefits and ease of use.If you’re available, I can do a 30-45 minute slot any weekday afternoon over the next two weeks; alternatively, I’m happy to share a short list of use cases and a sandbox dataset beforehand so the demo can be tailored to our needs. Please let me know a few windows that work for you and whether you prefer Zoom or another platform for the walkthrough. Thanks for building something practical for firms that want to work smarter, I’m looking forward to seeing Notal in action and exploring how we might move forward with a pilot.Best regards,Bary PrincePartner, Prince & Rexton LLP(123) 456-7890
